vendor_name.description: Name of the company issuing the invoice/bill (e.g. seller name for e-commerce, distribution company for electricity)

invoice_number.description: Unique invoice/bill identifier as printed on the document

invoice_date.description: Date the invoice/bill was issued. Normalize from whatever format appears (DD.MM.YYYY, DD/MM/YYYY, etc.)

due_date.description: Payment due date, if present (common on electricity bills, rare on e-commerce invoices)

line_items.description: List of purchased items or charged components. Empty array if not applicable (e.g. utility bills often don't itemize this way).

subtotal.description: Amount before tax, if separately stated

tax_amount.description: Total tax charged (GST, IGST, sales tax, etc.), if separately stated

total_amount.description: Final total amount payable/due, as the single source of truth figure

currency.description: Currency code or symbol as it appears (e.g. INR, Rs, EUR)

null_policy: If a field's value is not present in the document text, return null. Never guess, infer, or fabricate a plausible-looking value.
evidence_policy: Every non-null field must include the exact source text span it was extracted from, for auditability.
